environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Python 3.9 runtime) invoked as a Task state within a Step Functions Standard workflow. The Lambda execution role has s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject on the ETL buckets. The Step Functions state machine accepts input from an API Gateway endpoint with no input validation at the state machine definition level (Pass state feeds directly to Lambda task). No InputPath filtering or Parameters template applied in the Task state definition. Lambda runs in a VPC with outbound internet access via NAT gateway.

config.step_functions_definition: Task state with 'InputPath': '$' and no Parameters filtering
config.network: VPC with NAT gateway, outbound 0.0.0.0/0 allowed
config.api_gateway: REST API with no request validation model
